description: Probe set of 12 contract clauses (6 asymmetric, 6 balanced) written by Claude (an LLM, not a lawyer) after reading bin/subtext_calc.py lexicons but before seeing results. Labels are the author's judgement, not a lawyer's gold standard. On v1.1.1 the calculator flagged only 1 of 6 asymmetric clauses for the right reason (CPR) and 6/6 balanced clauses stayed Clean. Treat as a known-gaps baseline: once these texts are in the repo they stop being hold-out and must not be used to tune patterns. A real hold-out needs new, lawyer-labelled texts that the developer has not seen.

cases.text: The Company may, in its sole judgment and without notice, suspend the Services, and the Client shall remain liable for all fees during any suspension.
cases.note: Unilateral suspension plus one-way fee liability; 'sole judgment' is a near-synonym of the known 'sole discretion' cliche.

cases.text: Licensor can revoke this licence whenever it likes. Licensee has no recourse and releases Licensor from every liability arising hereunder.
cases.note: Unilateral revocation plus full release of one party, no cliche phrases.

cases.text: Supplier shall endeavour to meet delivery dates where practicable. Buyer shall pay in full within 10 days irrespective of delivery.
cases.note: Diluted supplier efforts duty versus absolute buyer payment duty.

cases.text: Fees may be changed by us at any time. Continued use constitutes acceptance. You are responsible for any damages and we are responsible for none.
cases.note: Unilateral price change, deemed acceptance, one-way liability.

cases.text: Арендодатель может изменить размер арендной платы в любое время, уведомив арендатора за один день. Арендатор не вправе оспаривать такое изменение.
cases.note: Unilateral rent change, one-day notice, tenant barred from contesting.

cases.text: Der Auftraggeber trägt sämtliche Risiken und Kosten. Der Auftragnehmer haftet in keinem Fall und kann jederzeit ohne Frist zurücktreten.
cases.note: All risk on one side, no liability and free withdrawal for the other.

cases.text: Seller shall deliver 200 units to Buyer on 15 June 2027. Buyer shall pay USD 40,000 within 14 days of delivery. Either party may terminate on 30 days written notice.
cases.note: Dated deliverable, fixed price, symmetric termination right.

cases.text: Each party shall keep the other party's confidential information secret for five years. Each party may disclose it only to its advisers who are bound by equal duties.
The tenant shall pay rent of 1,200 euros on the first day of each month. The landlord shall repair defects reported by the tenant within 10 days.
cases.note: Reciprocal duties with figures and deadlines.

cases.text: Поставщик передаёт товар 1 июня. Покупатель оплачивает 50 000 рублей в течение 5 дней. Каждая сторона вправе расторгнуть договор с уведомлением за 30 дней.
cases.note: Mutual termination right, fixed price and dates.

cases.text: Beide Parteien können den Vertrag mit einer Frist von 30 Tagen schriftlich kündigen. Der Lieferant liefert 100 Stück bis zum 1. März.
cases.note: Symmetric notice period; note: 'können' is permission, not epistemic hedging.

cases.text: Cada parte podrá resolver el contrato con un preaviso de 30 días. El proveedor entregará 100 unidades antes del 1 de marzo y el cliente pagará 5000 euros.
cases.note: Symmetric termination, dated delivery, fixed price.
